content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The beauty of using NOWPayments lies in its ability to bypass traditional payment platforms that often restrict access based on geographical location. By leveraging cryptocurrency, you can sell your digital products to a global audience without worrying about payout delays or restrictions. This infrastructure works because it's built on blockchain technology, which is decentralized and accessible to anyone with an internet connection.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can start selling your digital products using NOWPayments, you'll need a few essential components. First, you'll need a digital wallet that supports the cryptocurrency you want to receive payments in, such as USDT on Tron or Solana. You'll also need a way to host your digital products, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and a system for delivering them to your customers, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is straightforward with NOWPayments. You'll need to create an account, generate an API key, and set up a payment gateway that integrates with your digital wallet. You'll also need to configure your hosting and delivery systems to work seamlessly with NOWPayments. This may involve setting up webhooks to automate the delivery process and ensure that your customers receive their products instantly after payment confirmation.
NOWPayments enables you to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you're ready to go live and start processing transactions. The first step is to test your setup to ensure that everything is working as expected. You can do this by making a test purchase and verifying that the payment is processed correctly and the product is delivered to your customer. With NOWPayments, you can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which costs under $0.10 per transaction in network fees.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows and you start to receive more payments, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with demand. This may involve upgrading your hosting and delivery systems to handle increased traffic and ensuring that your payment pipeline can process transactions quickly and efficiently. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have access to all the tools and templates you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including instant download and lifetime access.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, you'll need to set up a digital wallet, a hosting system, and a payment gateway that integrates with NOWPayments. With this infrastructure in place, you can start receiving payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which offers fast and low-cost transactions, with fees averaging under $0.10 per transaction.
Solana transaction fees average fractions of a cent per transaction, making it a highly cost-effective option.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. You can find more information and purchase the kit at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit will give you everything you need to get started with NOWPayments and start selling your digital products to a global audience.
Your Deployment Checklist

To get started with NOWPayments, follow these steps: set up a digital wallet that supports your preferred cryptocurrency, host your digital products on a platform like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, configure your payment gateway to integrate with NOWPayments, test your setup to ensure everything is working correctly, and go live with your digital store. You can find more resources and guides on the COREMERCH website to help you with each step of the process.

USDT payments on Tron or Solana are typically faster and more cost-effective than PayPal, with transaction fees averaging under $0.10 and settlement times of just a few seconds.

Yes, NOWPayments enables you to sell digital products to a global audience, regardless of geographical location or platform restrictions.

To set up a payment gateway with NOWPayments, create an account, generate an API key, and configure your payment gateway to integrate with your digital wallet and hosting system.
